Greenfield Community Garden: steering group meeting
Date: 12 March 2026
Present: Ana Ruiz (chair), Tom Becker, Priya Shah, Lena Ortiz

1. Irrigation supplier
We compared supplier A and supplier B for the drip irrigation kit. Supplier B was
cheaper but could not commit to a delivery date.
Decision: the group agreed to buy the drip irrigation kit from supplier A, because
they guarantee delivery before the April planting. Supplier B is rejected for this
season.

2. Risks
Tom raised a concern: “the city’s permits office may delay the water connection
permit”, which would push back the planting date by several weeks. He thinks this
is quite likely given last year’s delays.
Ana will call the permits office every week and will escalate to the council if
there is no answer by 1 April.
Priya noted an opportunity — the local school might lend volunteers for the build
day; if so, we could finish a week early.

3. Open questions
Should we add a composting area? To be discussed next month.
